name: path-of-ragnarok
author: rhewid
description: Path of Ragnarok (made mainly for pre-renewal): a Path-of-Exile style passive skill tree for every character: your first class picks the origin in the centre, each job level earns a point, and 737 connected nodes give stats, resistances, damage against races and elements, skill boosts (including weak or neglected skills), status effects, auto-casts and free skill recasts, drains, weapon masteries, EXP and drop bonuses, utility skills, 12 trade-off keystones, job-line and rebirth branches, teleport rifts and choose-one masteries. 6 sockets take cards. Saved builds. Inner branches for Gunslinger, Ninja and Taekwon. 10 skill points on the outer ring buy any skill of any class (within your class tier) on the Skills tab; optionally the job skill points can too. Search it, open it with Alt+P or @passive.

settings.label: Most passive points a character can have
settings.description: The cap on points. Points come from job levels (see "Every job earns points"), so a character that goes through 1st, 2nd, transcended and 3rd class can use more than 50.

settings.label: Passive points per job level
settings.description: Job levels earn this many points each, up to the cap. With "Every job earns points" on this counts every job (1st, 2nd, transcended, 3rd...); off, only the levels of a first class count and a second class or beyond starts at the cap. 0 = nobody earns points.

settings.label: Every job earns points
settings.description: On: every job level of every job earns passive points (job levels already credited are never counted twice, a rebirth starts a new count). Off: the old rule, only first-class levels count and a second class or beyond starts at the cap.

settings.label: Refund price per node (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged for taking one node back. Reset all costs this once per allocated node. 0 = free.

settings.label: Bonus strength (%)
settings.description: Scales every number on the tree, penalties of keystones included. 100 = as designed, 50 = half, 200 = double.

settings.label: Most skill points
settings.description: The outer ring of the tree holds 10 skill point nodes. Each collected node gives one point to spend (one point per level) on any skill of any class on the Skills tab. This caps the total a character can use. 0 = switched off: nobody can spend points, skills already learned stay.

settings.label: Skills limited to your class tier
settings.description: On: skill points (ring and job points) only learn skills of your own tier and below: Novice, first class, second class, transcended, third class, fourth class. A first class cannot take a fourth class skill. Skills already learned stay.

settings.label: Job skill points can learn any skill
settings.description: On: the normal job skill points (the ones a job level gives) can be spent on the Skills tab on any skill of any class (within the tier limit), but the skill's own prerequisites must be met. Ring points ignore prerequisites. Using the skill reset NPC gives these points back and takes the skills back.

settings.label: Skill point ring again after rebirth
settings.description: On: when a character is reborn the skills it learned with ring points are kept for good and the ring nodes are given back for free, so the ring can be taken a second time. Off: the ring is taken only once.

settings.label: Show the PT button in game
settings.description: The window still opens with Alt+P and with the @passive command.

settings.label: Card sockets
settings.description: Off: the card sockets of the tree do nothing and cards in them are not applied (they can still be taken out).

settings.label: Allow MVP cards in sockets
settings.description: Cards dropped by MVP monsters are very strong. Off: they cannot be socketed.

settings.label: Socketing price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged each time a card is put into a socket. Taking one out is free. 0 = free.

settings.label: Most keystones a character can take
settings.description: Keystones are the powerful trade-off nodes. Once a character has this many, no further keystone can be allocated until one is refunded. 0 = no limit. A character that already has more keeps them.

settings.label: Most extra item drop rate the tree can give (%)
settings.description: The drop rate nodes add up (0.1% for a small node, 1% for Golden Gamble) and the total is capped at this. The server only accepts whole percents, so nothing applies until the total reaches 1%. 0 = the tree gives no drop rate. Cards in sockets are not part of this.

settings.label: Saved builds per character
settings.description: How many tree builds a character can save and swap between (0 to 5). 0 = the build slots are switched off.

settings.label: Swapping to a saved build: price (zeny)
settings.description: Zeny charged each time a saved build is loaded over the current tree. Saving a build is free. 0 = free. Loading may also charge the card socketing price for every card put back in.
